stem: A valence electron experiences a screening constant that is 2 units less than the number of inner electrons. If an atom has 20 inner electrons and its atomic number is 29, what is the effective nuclear charge (Z*) on the valence electron? (a) 7 (b) 9 (c) 11 (d) 17

In a heteronuclear molecule A–B with a very small electronegativity difference (so that r AB ≈ r A + r B ), the bond length is 1.40 Å and the covalent radius of A is 0.65 Å. Calculate the covalent radius of B. (a) 0.55 Å (b) 0.65 Å (c) 0.75 Å (d) 0.85 Å

For a valence electron in the 3p orbital, which set of electrons contributes 1.00 each to the shielding constant? (a) Electrons in the 3d group (b) Electrons in the 1s group (c) Electrons in the (n−1) shell (d) Electrons to the right of 3p in its group

Identify the correct statement(s): Statement I: Metallic radius is defined as half of the distance between the nuclei of two adjacent metal atoms in a metallic crystal lattice. Statement II: Across a period, atomic radius increases because effective nuclear charge decreases. (a) Only Statement I (b) Only Statement II (c) Both I and II (d) Neither I nor II

Using Slater's rules, calculate the shielding constant (σ) for a 3p electron in Sulfur (Z = 16). Electronic configuration of S (grouped as per Slater): (1s²)(2s² 2p⁶)(3s² 3p⁴). (a) 10.55 (b) 11.25 (c) 12.40 (d) 13.10
